Hurworth School Announces Vacancy for Mini Bus Driver

03 Nov 2026, 04:28 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: teaching-vacancies.service.gov.uk

2 min read

Key takeawaysHurworth School has officially announced a vacancy for a Mini Bus Driver to provide student transport services. According to the school's announcement, applications are currently open, with a closing date set for 13 November 2026 at 12:00 PM (midday).

Job Opportunity at Hurworth School

Hurworth School has officially announced a vacancy for a Mini Bus Driver to provide student transport services. According to the school's announcement, applications are currently open, with a closing date set for 13 November 2026 at 12:00 PM (midday).

Role and Responsibilities

The successful applicant will be responsible for:

  • Collecting students each morning before school.
  • Transporting students to and from Hurworth School safely.
  • Ensuring an efficient, professional, and reliable transport service.

Requirements and Qualifications

Based on the published job specifications, applicants should note the following criteria:

  • A full, clean driving licence is required.
  • At least 2 years of driving experience.
  • A good knowledge of the surrounding areas is considered an advantage.
  • Licence category D1 is not essential, as necessary training will be provided by the institution.
  • Candidates must be punctual, reliable, and aware of safeguarding responsibilities.

Application Procedure and Verification

Applicants must use the official channels provided by the issuing authority to apply:

  • The online application form and further details can be accessed via the official portal at nalp.face-ed.co.uk/vacancies.
  • CVs will not be accepted for this application process.
  • For technical difficulties with the online application, applicants may contact Sam Recruit at 01924 907319 or email the People Team at people@nalp.org.uk.
  • For informal inquiries or to discuss the post, contact Mr Geoff Ward, Building Maintenance Supervisor, via email at gward@hurworth/nalp.org.uk or by telephone at 01325 720424.

Additional Recruitment Checks

  • An enhanced DBS check is mandatory for this post. Candidates will either need to apply for a DBS check or provide consent for the Trust to check their status if registered with the Update Service.
  • An online search of publicly available information will be conducted for shortlisted candidates in line with KCSIE guidelines, which can be discussed further during the interview stage.
